name: Kakizawa Itaru
source:
"Shall we talk about your dream soon?"

The protagonist's counselor and homeroom teacher.
He's an old friend of [url=/c46272]Akito[/url] from their high school days.
An elusive and slippery bad adult who doesn't know how to take care of himself.
